title: The Secret World of Arrietty
description: The Clock family consists of three four-inch-tall people who live incognito among humans, borrowing only what they need to survive. Their quiet life changes when their teenage daughter, Arrietty, is discovered.

title: Ghost in the Shell (1995)
description: A cyborg policewoman and her partner hunt a mysterious and powerful hacker called the Puppet Master.

title: Iron Lung
description: In a post-apocalyptic future after 'The Quiet Rapture' event, a convict explores a blood ocean on a desolate moon using a submarine called the 'Iron Lung' to search for missing stars/planets.

title: Project Hail Mary
description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

title: Alien
description: After investigating a mysterious transmission of unknown origin, the crew of a commercial spacecraft encounters a deadly lifeform.

title: The Room
description: In San Francisco, an amiable banker's seemingly perfect life is turned upside down when his deceitful bride-to-be embarks on a passionate affair with his best friend.
